From the seal colony viewpoint, follow the signs to Cape Foulwind.
From the lighthouse, it’s another 15 min to Cape Foulwind car park.

doubts: Start: the Tauranga Bay car park has no road-end feature; T4 is the Tauranga Bay coast name, so the ref is a judgement that the car park is at the bay. End: F1 is the road end where an unnamed track meets Lighthouse Road, which the text says leads to the Cape Foulwind car park. The walkway can be walked from either end, which is the same route reversed, so it is an access point rather than a separate way. W2 and W3 have their own headings and times ('30 min / 1 km (return)' and '2 hr / 5.8 km (return)'), so they are separate out and back ways; the time and distance are split from those lines. The text says the Kawatiri Coastal Trail can be used to return from the Cape Foulwind car park end; its exit point is taken as that car park. The Wall Island lookout side track is not stated to leave from any named place on the way, so from is null. Cape Foulwind lighthouse lookout has no feature or name entry, so its ref is null.
